# PR:127 — sqlx 0.9.0 to 0.9.1

Date: 2026-11-21
Status: merged as `879ee56`

## Intent

Dependabot bump of `sqlx` from 0.9.0 to 0.9.1 in `/rust/signal-core`.

## Review

- `rust/signal-core/Cargo.lock` only.
- `sqlx` package entry moves 0.9.0 to 0.9.1 with the new registry
  checksum.
- New transitive entries appear: `libredox 0.1.25` and
  `objc2-core-foundation 0.3.2` (platform-specific optional
  dependencies surfaced by the sqlx bump), plus `sha2 0.11.1`
  references deduplicated to `sha2` where a single sha2 version now
  exists in the graph.
- The `signal-core` package version and the release-please marker
  comment in `Cargo.lock` are untouched.
- Provenance: Dependabot branch, generated commit `a89a429`.

## Risk

Low-to-moderate. sqlx is the store's database driver; the 0.9.0 to
0.9.1 change is a patch release. PR CI does not exercise the
release-only artifact paths, but the normal build, Debian 13, and
Ubuntu 24.04 jobs all pass.

## Validation

- PR CI (build-and-test, debian-13-build-and-install,
  ubuntu-24-04-build-and-install) and dependency review passed before
  merge.
- Merged via `gh pr merge --merge` after explicit approval.
